had an appointment on 16th Feb,2026 with a physiotherapist at Porter Brook and I do not believe it was handled correctly or appropriately. I went regarding discomfort I have had with my left knee and at no point was I asked to show the leg in question or have any sort of physical assessment.

Instead I was basically sent links via text telling me to lose weight and be more active. It is true that I am overweight however I have been losing weight and this symptom only developed a couple of years ago. I walk a decent amount and I am active, working a job that requires me to be walking for a reasonable period and also going to the gym.

I did try to ask a follow-up question about a foot pain I have in the mornings (again only gotten recently) but was told that it was only a 15 minute appointment and to book another appointment in six weeks time - it is worth noting that the appointment was booked at 4:30 and I was only called in by the physio at 4:47, with the appointment ending at 4:56.

I didn’t feel that my issues were listened to or looked into properly in my physio appointment - the GP who referred me did actually take a look at my leg, but the physiotherapist did not. The links, whilst helpful, did not tell me anything I didn’t already know and I feel that I was just sent away with this information as opposed to being looked at to definitively rule out any other issues aside from being overweight.

Reply- when you said detailed consultation and various methods meant sending me two links which is telling me what knee pain was and planter fasciitis. The physio told me only to go to gym and do movement which my work is already physical demanding.
